topic: Modern agriculture has fundamentally altered human genetic expression
subject: science

facts.claim: The quantity and type of fat modulate both beneficial and potentially detrimental microbes, as well as the Firmicutes/Bacteroides ratio in the gut.
facts.quote: The preclinical evidence suggests that both the quantity and type of fat modulate both beneficial and potentially detrimental microbes, as well as the Firmicutes/Bacteroides ratio in the gut.

facts.claim: Dietary fibers like arabinoxylans, galacto-oligosaccharides, inulin, and oligofructose promote a range of beneficial bacteria and suppress potentially detrimental species.
facts.quote: Current research shows consistent clinical evidence that dietary fibers, including arabinoxylans, galacto-oligosaccharides, inulin, and oligofructose, promote a range of beneficial bacteria and suppress potentially detrimental species.

facts.claim: The food metabolome is defined as the part of the human metabolome directly derived from the digestion and biotransformation of foods and their constituents.
facts.quote: The food metabolome is defined as the part of the human metabolome directly derived from the digestion and biotransformation of foods and their constituents.

rejected.claim: Polyphenol intake is linked to a moderate-to-large effect size of increased Bifidobacterium abundance (SMD = 0. 81; 95% CI: 0. 18-1. 44; p = 0. 0114).
rejected.quote: The meta-analysis revealed a significant positive effect of polyphenol intake on Bifidobacterium abundance (SMD = 0. 81; 95% CI: 0. 18-1. 44; p = 0. 0114), corresponding to a moderate-to-large effect size.

rejected.claim: A ketogenic diet makes the human metabolome change in only three weeks, including reduced quinolinic acid (-13. 46% ± 6. 12%, p = 0. 0478) and elevated kynurenic acid concentrations (+10. 70% ± 4. 25%, p = 0. 0269).
rejected.quote: A KD fundamentally changes the human metabolome even after a short period of only three weeks. ... revealed changes to the tryptophan pathway depicting reduced quinolinic acid (-13. 46% ± 6. 12%, p = 0. 0478) and elevated kynurenic acid concentrations (+10. 70% ± 4. 25%, p = 0. 0269).

research.angle: While specific dietary components like polyphenols, fibers, and fats can modulate gut microbes and a ketogenic diet can rapidly reshape the human metabolome, the sources do not provide evidence that modern agriculture has fundamentally altered human genetic expression.
research.verdict: The evidence shows that specific dietary inputs significantly influence the human metabolome and gut microbiota composition, but it does not establish a link to fundamental changes in human genetic expression.
research.caveat: The sources lack any data regarding long-term genetic expression or the specific impact of modern agricultural livestock production on human genetics.
